aaa_enabled.summary: Configure external TACACS+ / RADIUS authentication on SONiC.
aaa_enabled.notes: Ensures authentication requests are processed centrally.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable telnet and ensure SSH is enabled.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Sets automatic CLI shell teardown to 600 seconds.

cli: config user add admin password <strong-password> role admin
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Use strong passwords for default administrative accounts.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Remove default SNMP communities like public and private.

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable the unencrypted HTTP management daemon.

ssh_version_2.notes: SSH version 2 is the default on modern Linux baselines.

logging_enabled.summary: Add central remote syslog server in SONiC config.
logging_enabled.notes: Forwards containerized and kernel logs to central syslog host.

management_acl.summary: Configure ACL rule for management interface access.
cli: config acl add rule MGMT permit_ssh --src 10.20.30.0/24 --dport 22
management_acl.notes: Restricts access to management port by IP prefix.

cli: config banner login "Authorized Access Only. Activity is monitored."

password_min_length.summary: Configure password quality minimum length requirements.
password_min_length.notes: Restricts users from creating weak passwords.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: Only read-only SNMP communities are permitted.
